findings.summary: MergeStage._publish_release guards RELEASE_HEAD_ADVANCED only when both the local line branch resolves and the remote probe returns a head ('observed and frozen'). If configure found the line branch absent (frozen empty, no local sync) and another order created or advanced the remote branch before this merger ran, the guard is skipped, _stripped_commit builds a parentless commit, and the --force-with-lease=<ref>:<observed> push succeeds against the just-probed head, replacing the remote line branch and silently discarding the other order's landed commits -- an edge-case breach of behavior contract 3's pre-push recheck ('被他人前进则失败留痕…不覆盖他人提交'). Not covered by test_it_creates_the_branch_when_absent (absent at merge) nor by the frozen 13/14 probes; reachable when a fresh line's first two orders race. Remedy: refuse when observed is set and frozen is empty (CAS basis unverifiable -- re-run configure).

The release-path probe (ls-remote) and push in _publish_release call self._git directly, bypassing the retry_remote egress wrapper the legacy path uses (dd_scripts.py:721-728), while MergeStage's docstring (dd_scripts.py:533-536) and the build_pipeline wiring comment (dd_runner.py:393-395) claim transport-class failures retry under the stage fence. A transient network failure on the probe (returncode != 2) or the push therefore becomes a non-retried MERGE_REFUSED repo verdict -- misclassified and requiring re-dispatch instead of an in-fence retry.
